newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish H1 oil product sales fall 3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish H1 oil product sales fall 3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish January-June oil product sales fell by three percent year-on-year to 4.16 million tonnes, the Finnish Petroleum Association said in its monthly review on Monday.
Diesel oil sales rose by seven percent to 0.78 million tonnes and motor petroleum sales rose three percent to 0.90 million tonnes, it said.

The decrease in total sales was due to declines in domestic heating oil, down six percent to 1.08 million tonnes, industrial heating oil, down 13 percent to 0.64 million tonnes and other oil products, down seven percent to 0.76 million tonnes.
The association said it opposed the raise in the motor petroleum tax planned by the finance ministry for the 1998 state budget.
